hero.h1: Directive 8020 Cast | Lashana Lynch as Brianna Young
hero.intro: Meet the officially confirmed lead, understand Young’s role aboard the Cassiopeia and check performance credits without guessing the rest of the cast.

blocks.text: The official character profile names Lashana Lynch as Brianna Young, the Cassiopeia’s pilot. The former name Brooke Osmond was incorrect and has been withdrawn.

Young is Bill Young’s daughter and trained to follow him into spaceflight. Stafford became her mentor after her father’s death. These are official background details, not evidence of any particular ending.

sections.heading: Characters and performers are different records

blocks.text: A character’s job does not identify the performer. Use the official roster for crew names and duties; use the game’s credits to distinguish acting, voice, likeness and motion capture.

Read the credits for your version and audio language. A recognizable face does not by itself prove who supplied the voice, and an English performance credit does not identify a localized voice actor. Unconfirmed credits remain unconfirmed.
